intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A herald is rehearsing Tavri’s introduction nearby, gulping air between adjectives.

intro.speaker: HERALD
intro.text: “Presenting the illustrious! The indomitable! The magnificent! The incandescent…”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “He’s been at it for a while. He hasn’t reached my name yet.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Now I’ll have to be indomitable enough to justify the paperwork.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The herald pauses to breathe into a paper bag.

options.labelText: “Want me to ask him to just say ‘Tavri’? Save the man a lung.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Plain. Terrifying. Go, before he finds a thesaurus.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: When you ask, the herald sits down on the spot, weak with relief.

options.labelText: “He’s missing ‘majestic.’ There’s room before his next breath.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Lovely. I’ll be over here, practicing majestic.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The herald starts again. He still doesn’t reach her name.
